title: Twist Up
logline: Marcus Bell offers Michael a Staples-branded pretzel for every Dunder client, Dwight declares himself Pretzel Day security chief, and Stanley learns his one joy has a logo on it.
outline: A: Michael wants Marcus Bell to like him, so he hands Staples co-host rights to Pretzel Day, then learns Marcus is poaching Dale Pruitt. B: Dwight and Andy fight over Love Board 2.0 chair; Dwight seizes Pretzel Day security and locks Stanley out. C: Pam reads Jim's email about Karen and the Stamford pretzel cart; Pam notices more than she admits. Order: cold, A, C, B, A, C, B, A, C, B, A, tag.
theme: Who gets the seat at the table, and whether being liked is the same as being there.
storySoFar: Jim is in Stamford, calling and emailing Pam carefully; Karen Filippelli, his Stamford colleague, is friendly and direct and keeps showing up in his messages. Pam keeps Jim's card on her desk unanswered and drafts replies she never sends; Roy keeps pushing the June 14 wedding. Michael covered for Pam on Jim's call and says he won't lie for her again. Michael runs Love Board 2.0 as a mandate from Gerald Boyd's letters, with Dwight and Andy as co-chairs who hate each other; Toby's Section 9 notice hangs over the board. Angela's Party Planning Committee is split: Kelly and Phyllis want a Sweetheart Social, Angela wants a Garden Party. Dwight and Angela's secret is known to Oscar and Kevin. Marcus Bell from Staples is poaching clients and charming Michael into co-hosting Pretzel Day. Stanley is at 193.

stateChanges.arc: Michael Wants to Be the Favorite
stateChanges.progress: Michael gives Marcus Bell Pretzel Day co-host rights to win his approval; Marcus uses it to poach Dale Pruitt. Michael is hurt and admits he wanted to be liked, then takes Pretzel Day back for Stanley.

stateChanges.arc: Dwight vs Andy for Number Two
stateChanges.progress: Dwight seizes Pretzel Day security and locks Stanley out; Andy objects. Co-chair fight over Love Board 2.0 continues.
Karen is friendly with Jim by phone and email; Pam reads it and notices, and keeps the card unanswered.

stateChanges.text: Dale Pruitt was poached by Marcus Bell after the Pretzel Day pitch; Dale is a paper account at risk.
Dwight's Staples pretzel crate is in the evidence pile; Dwight's checkpoint sign hangs on the break room door.
Michael's 'That's what she said' dies on silence to Stanley's countdown (194 cold open, 193 tag); Kevin's 'Nobody say nothing' closes cold open and tag.
Andy's bear-paw phone plays banjo hold music; Oscar: 'Actually, that's a banjo on hold.'

scenes.recap: Andy's bear-paw phone plays banjo hold music, and Michael's joke about Stanley's countdown dies in the bullpen.

beats.caption: holds up bear-paw phone; banjo hold music starts

beats.text: Actually, that's a banjo on hold.
194 days.
194 days, Stanley? That's what she said.
Nobody say nothing.

scenes.recap: Marcus Bell from Staples charms Michael into co-hosting Pretzel Day with a Staples pretzel for every client.

beats.text: Marcus Bell! Big Staples! Sit, sit, you're a sitter.
Mike. I'm not here to poach. I'm here to share a pretzel.
Staples is sending every client a soft pretzel. Twist Up for Staples.
We have a Pretzel Day. It's Stanley's Pretzel Day.
Stanley who?
Co-host! Pretzel Day, Staples edition. We're a team.

lines: Marcus took two of our clients last year. He also calls me Mike.
Nobody calls me Mike unless they want something. I'm not bribable. I'm a pretzel guy.

beats.text: You're my favorite Dunder guy, Mike.

scenes.recap: Pam reads Jim's email about Karen and the Stamford pretzel cart, and Phyllis notices the face.

beats.caption: reads an email on screen for the third time

beats.text: Is that from Jim?
It's from Jim. And Karen.
Who's Karen?
She's in sales in Stamford. She's copied. It's fine.
Karen took me to the pretzel cart. Not Pretzel Day, but close.

lines: Karen is nice. She's direct. She told Jim his tie looked like a hostage situation.
I didn't ask if she's nice. I just noticed she's nice.

beats.text: Pam, you're doing the face.

scenes.recap: Dwight and Andy fight over who chairs Love Board 2.0, and Dwight announces he is Pretzel Day security.

beats.text: Question: who is the chair of Love Board 2.0?
We're co-chairs, Dwight. Michael said co-chairs. We share the gavel.
False. Chair means head. I am the head.
You're the head of beets.
Also, Michael put me in charge of Pretzel Day security.
He did not.
He said, Dwight, handle it. I am handling it.
I will have a checkpoint at the break room door.
You can't search Stanley.

lines: Andy has a banjo. I have a badge from the volunteer sheriff's department.
Only one of these stops a pretzel.

scenes.recap: Michael unveils Pretzel Day, Staples edition, to the office, and Stanley is not amused.

beats.text: Pretzel Day is now Pretzel Day, presented by Staples!
Twist Up Thursday. Logo on the bag, logo on the napkin.
Pretzel Day is on the third Thursday. It has been on the third Thursday since 1989.
Stanley, it's a new era. Think of it as a rebrand.
Pretzels with a logo are so cute. Like a little Staples baby.

beats.caption: breaks into a short a cappella tribute to the Staples pretzel

lines: He put a logo on my day. That's what happens when you let a man in a golf visor name your holiday.
Two hundred and... one hundred ninety-three. I'm going to count them harder.

scenes.recap: Stanley vents to Creed about his stolen day, and Creed says something unsettling that nobody follows up.

beats.caption: fills in a crossword clue in pen, pressing hard

beats.text: I once knew a man who counted down to something. He's still counting. In a lake.
Did I stutter?
Pretzels are the only bread that never forgave anyone. I believe that.
Mm. Don't.

lines: Pretzel Day is the one day I don't count. Now there's a logo on it.
So I'm counting. It's a Staples pretzel, but I'm counting it too.

scenes.recap: Dwight seizes the Staples pretzel crates as evidence and turns the break room into a checkpoint.

beats.caption: tapes a yellow EVIDENCE sticker on a crate of Staples pretzels

beats.text: Question: who ordered these pretzels?
Marcus ordered them. Michael signed off.
False. Marcus did not sign. These are unauthorized pretzels.
They're pretzels, Dwight.
You are not on the checkpoint list, Stanley.

beats.caption: carries the crate out past the sign reading CHECKPOINT

lines: Michael said handle it. Handling is my specialty. I was a volunteer deputy for six years.
Stanley is a suspect. He had a pretzel in 2009 that I did not see.

beats.text: That is not what handle it means.

scenes.recap: Marcus admits he is poaching Dale Pruitt and Michael realizes he was used.

beats.text: Mike, I'm taking Dale Pruitt. Dale wants a guy who closes.
Dale? Dale's my friend. Dale is my... paper friend.
You're a sweetheart, Mike. Sweethearts don't get paper.

beats.caption: Michael realizes what he gave away.

beats.text: But we're golf buddies.
We've never golfed, Mike.

lines: I wanted Marcus to like me. He liked the pretzels. Which is basically a pretzel.
I gave him Stanley's day so he would think I'm cool. He thinks I'm a folding chair.

beats.text: Get out, Marcus.

scenes.recap: Kelly teases Pam about Karen, and Pam admits nothing while her drafts sit in the drawer.

beats.caption: opens her reception drawer; unsent drafts stacked inside

beats.text: Is Karen the one who sounds like a news anchor? She sounds so direct.
Karen's direct. Good for her.
Ooh. You're jealous.
I'm working.

lines: Karen said Jim has a face that can't lie. I didn't say anything. I wrote it down.

scenes.recap: Dwight locks Stanley out of his own Pretzel Day and Michael arrives to find Stanley in the hallway.

beats.caption: stands in the doorway with a clipboard labeled PRETZEL SECURITY

beats.text: Stanley, pretzel entry requires a badge.
I've come to this room for thirty years.
False. Twenty. I checked.
Actually, Dwight, that is a violation of Michael's own memo on break room access.
Oscar, you are now a suspect.

beats.caption: bursts into a cappella about access control, then loses his place

beats.text: Dwight, why is Stanley in the hallway?
Michael, you said handle it.
I said handle it, not handle Stanley!

scenes.recap: Michael tells Marcus to leave, gives Stanley back his day, and Stanley hands him a pretzel.

beats.text: Marcus, Staples isn't coming. Pretzel Day belongs to Stanley.
You're an odd bird, Mike.
I gave your Twist Up to a golf visor and a logo. It's Stanley's.
Did I stutter?

beats.caption: tears a pretzel in half and holds out the bigger half

beats.text: Stanley, this is the bigger half.
Don't make it weird.
Question: am I still Pretzel Day Chief?
Dwight, Stanley is Pretzel Day Chief. You're his deputy.
False. I am the sheriff.

lines: Stanley's been coming to Pretzel Day since before I got here. I'm the guy who didn't check.
The best thing I did today was give him back a pretzel. Don't tell Marcus I said that.

scenes.recap: Stanley's countdown drops to 193, Michael's joke dies on silence, and Kevin closes it out.

beats.text: 193 days.
193 days, Stanley? That's what she said.

beats.caption: Stanley looks at him. Michael waits.

beats.text: Nobody say nothing.
Mm.
